methodology: Keep historical components as distinct source identities, including liturgical event/group identities; never treat these as unique people by default.
Reuse exact canonical person IDs when byte-identical across historical, canonization and Doctor source records; do not assert two differently named IDs are the same person from name similarity.
Keep 13 post-1960 collective martyr group entries as collective cards, not every member as an individual art subject.
Keep 75 earlier artistic subjects as a separate explicit UNJOINED namespace until Calendar/Saints owner validates their equivalence; prevents false-positive 5/5 calendar coverage.
This union is an upper bound of source-keyed requirement records, not a certified denominator of distinct calendar saints, because aliases/overlap remain.
No new historical or 1962 liturgical dates are invented for post-1960 saints; none automatically affects the traditional Mass formulary.
Selection of a five-star painting does not certify exact image/photo/master/right to release.

Historical source inventory has 311 components over 252 calendar dates and 307 distinct historical source identities. The full amended calendar universe also includes later saints and Doctor roster entries.
No rewriting of source owner registers or historical user ratings; no requests for permissions/paid licences.
